body:
Thursday, August 13, 2026, 5:40 PM ET

Nu Holdings (NU) reported earnings of $0.22 per share on revenue of $5.51 billion for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.20 per share on revenue of $5.45 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.21 per share. The company beat expectations by 4.76% while revenue grew 50.29% on a year-over-year basis.

The consensus earnings estimate is $0.77 per share on revenue of $1.62 billion, respresenting 11.0% year-over-year revenue growth, and the Earnings Whisper ® number is $0.89 per share. Investors are 28.8% bullish going into the company's earnings release. Option traders are pricing in a 10.7% move on earnings and the stock has averaged a 15.3% move in recent quarters.
